pages.title: Superposition Crystal
pages.text: A crystal lattice that has not decided which arrangement of atoms it is in, so it occupies several configurations at once. Its outline shimmers slightly at the edges, and its weight seems to vary depending on how I hold it. Every facet reflects a slightly different room.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I placed a Qubit on a scrap of Foam Substrate in the Quantum Entangler, hoping to stabilise it. Instead the qubit's indecision spread into the substrate, and the whole lattice entered superposition without collapsing.

Made in $(item)Quantum Entangler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Entanglement.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Transistor, Claytronic Catom, Crystalline Matrix Ingot, Error-Correction Lattice, General AI Core, Hyperframe Casing, Neural Synthesizer, Psionic Crystal and more.
